features.name: AC Bonus
features.description:
A treetop monk is highly trained at dodging blows, and she has a sixth sense that lets her avoid even unanticipated attacks.

When unarmored and unencumbered, the treetop monk adds her Wisdom bonus (if any) (this bonus is halved if she has a level in another non-prestige class and this is not her favored class) to her AC and her CMD. If the treetop monk gains an attribute bonus to her AC or CMD from some other source, it does not stack.

In addition, a treetop monk gains a +1 bonus to AC and CMD at 4th level. This bonus increases by 1 for every four monk levels thereafter, up to a maximum of +5 at 20th level. These bonuses to AC apply even against touch attacks or when the treetop monk is flat-footed.

She loses these bonuses when she is immobilized or helpless, when she wears any armor, when she carries a shield, or when she carries a medium or heavy load.

This ability replaces bodybuilding.

features.name: Ki Pool
features.description:
A treetop monk gains additional ki pool points from her Wisdom modifier instead of her Constitution modifier. Additionally, abilities that use her ki pool key off of her Wisdom instead of her Constitution.

This ability modifies ki pool.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description:
At 3rd level, a treetop monk gains a +10 foot enhancement bonus to her land speed. This bonus increases by an additional 10 feet at every third level past 3rd. A treetop monk in armor or carrying a medium or heavy load loses this extra speed.

This ability replaces boost and zen.

features.name: Wood Affinity
features.description:
At 6th level, a treetop monk may expend 1 point from her ki pool as a [free action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#free) to treat a wooden object as if it were not broken for 1 minute (this includes a weapon with a wooden haft such as an axe or spear).

At 8th level, as a [free action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#free), a treetop monk can expend 1 point from her ki pool to use the [Lunge](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/lunge-combat-final/) feat with any wooden or wood-hafted melee weapon.

This ability replaces a blitz technique gained at 6th level.

features.name: Freedom of Movement
features.description:
At 13th level, a treetop monk may expend 1 point from her ki pool as a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift) to gain the effects of [*freedom of movement*](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/spells/f/freedom-of-movement/) for a number of rounds equal to her monk level.

This ability replaces a reinforced fortitude.

features.name: Inner Fire
features.description:
At 19th level, the treetop monk attains the ability to draw out her latent power, bolstering her defenses. As a [standard action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#standard), the treetop monk gains a source of DR/-, with this amount being equal to the monk’s Wisdom bonus. This effect stacks with any existing sources of DR/-, and lasts for 1 minute.

The treetop monk can use this ability 3 times per day.

This ability replaces inner strength.
